summary: The bin/ directory may contain only symlinks to executables in lib/ansible/ or test/lib/ansible_test/, and each entry point also needs a symlink in the injector directory pointing to python.py.
questions: What does the bin-symlinks sanity test check?
Can I put a real script in Ansible's bin directory?

answer_card.title: bin-symlinks test
answer_card.answer_md:
- `bin/` must hold only symlinks to executables under `lib/ansible/` or `test/lib/ansible_test/`.
- Each entry point also needs a symlink in `test/lib/ansible_test/_util/target/injector/` pointing to `python.py` there.

This lets ansible-test work with containers, remote hosts and coverage.
